description: List what the profile's own posts and numbers suggest doing next, strongest first. Each one has a `kind` and the measured `facts` behind it, never a sentence: `subject` (a subject it is known for, and the weeks since it last posted about it), `cadence` (posts a week, `was` in the month before last and `now` in the last month), `format` (`posts` it made without a single carousel), `repeat_winner` (a post about `subject` got `times` the profile's usual `metric`), `template` (its post patterns were drafted from less than SmartGenius can read now). `postId` is set once a suggestion became a post. `sourceMediaIds` are the Instagram media ids it was measured on. The list is measured again each time SmartGenius reads the profile. It only reads.

profile.description: A profile's handle from list_profiles, or its permanent UUID
